# Action Dialogs

## Introduction

This guide explains how to render UI to perform actions such as creating, updating, and deleting records using Shadcn UI dialogs.

It covers how to provide shared dialog state, render dialogs, manage open and close behavior, and implement dialogs for creating or updating features.

The examples use the users feature, but you can adapt this pattern to other features.

## Provide shared dialog state

The `useDialogState` hook tracks the active dialog and returns a setter to update it. Its initial value defaults to `null`, indicating that no dialog is open. Passing a dialog type to the setter opens that dialog, or closes it if it is already active. Pass `null` to close any open dialog.

```tsx title="src/hooks/use-dialog-state.tsx"
import { useState } from 'react'

export default function useDialogState<T extends string | boolean>(
  initialState: T | null = null
) {
  const [open, _setOpen] = useState<T | null>(initialState)

  const setOpen = (str: T | null) =>
    _setOpen((prev) => (prev === str ? null : str))

  return [open, setOpen] as const
}
```

Next, create a React context to store the active dialog and the entity being acted upon. Use a provider component to make this state and its setters available throughout the component tree.

```tsx title="src/features/users/components/users-provider.tsx"
type UsersDialogType = 'add' | 'edit' | 'delete'

type UsersContextType = {
  open: UsersDialogType | null
  setOpen: (str: UsersDialogType | null) => void
  currentRow: User | null
  setCurrentRow: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<User | null>>
}

const UsersContext = React.createContext<UsersContextType | null>(null)

export function UsersProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useDialogState<UsersDialogType>(null)
  const [currentRow, setCurrentRow] = useState<User | null>(null)

  return (
    <UsersContext value={{ open, setOpen, currentRow, setCurrentRow }}>
      {children}
    </UsersContext>
  )
}

export function useUsers() {
  const usersContext = React.useContext(UsersContext)

  if (!usersContext) {
    throw new Error('useUsers has to be used within <UsersContext>')
  }

  return usersContext
}
```

`UsersContextType` defines the shared dialog state:
- `open`: identifies the active dialog type, or is `null` when no dialog is open.
- `setOpen`: toggles the specified dialog. Pass `null` to close any active dialog.
- `currentRow`: stores the entity being edited or acted upon.
- `setCurrentRow`: sets or clears the selected entity.

`UsersProvider` owns the context value and makes it available to its descendants.

`useUsers()` retrieves this context. Descendants of `UsersProvider` can use it to read or update the shared state.

## Render dialogs

```tsx title="src/features/users/components/users-dialogs.tsx"
import { UsersActionDialog } from './users-action-dialog'
import { UsersDeleteDialog } from './users-delete-dialog'
import { useUsers } from './users-provider'

export function UsersDialogs() {
  const { open, setOpen, currentRow, setCurrentRow } = useUsers()
  return (
    <>
      <UsersActionDialog
        key='user-add'
        open={open === 'add'}
        onOpenChange={() => setOpen('add')}
      />

      {currentRow && (
        <>
          <UsersActionDialog
            key={`user-edit-${currentRow.id}`}
            open={open === 'edit'}
            onOpenChange={() => {
              setOpen('edit')
              setTimeout(() => {
                setCurrentRow(null)
              }, 500)
            }}
            currentRow={currentRow}
          />

          <UsersDeleteDialog
            key={`user-delete-${currentRow.id}`}
            open={open === 'delete'}
            onOpenChange={() => {
              setOpen('delete')
              setTimeout(() => {
                setCurrentRow(null)
              }, 500)
            }}
            currentRow={currentRow}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </>
  )
}
```


The `UsersDialogs` component reads the dialog state (`open` and `currentRow`) and renders the appropriate dialog.

The `UsersActionDialog` component handles both create and update dialogs because they share the same structure and logic. The mode depends on whether `currentRow` is present:
- The add dialog is rendered when `open` is `add`.
- The edit dialog is rendered only when `open` is `edit` and a user is selected in `currentRow`.

The `UsersDeleteDialog` component displays a confirmation dialog for deleting a selected user. It is rendered only when `open` is `delete` and a user is selected in `currentRow`.


## Open dialogs

To create an entity, call `setOpen('add')`. To update, first store the selected entity, then call `setOpen('edit')`.

```tsx title="src/features/users/components/users-primary-buttons.tsx"
export function UsersPrimaryButtons() {
  const { setOpen } = useUsers()
  return (
    <div className='flex gap-2'>
      <Button className='space-x-1' onClick={() => setOpen('add')}>
        <span>Add User</span> <UserPlus size={18} />
      </Button>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx title="src/features/users/components/data-table-row-actions.tsx"
function EditUserAction({ row }: { row: Row<User> }) {
  const { setOpen, setCurrentRow } = useUsers()

  return (
    <DropdownMenuItem
      onClick={() => {
        setCurrentRow(row.original)
        setOpen('edit')
      }}
    >
      Edit
    </DropdownMenuItem>
  )
}
```


## Implement a dialog

The `UsersActionDialog` component accepts an optional `currentRow`, a controlled `open` value, and an `onOpenChange` callback.

Providing `currentRow` enables **edit mode**.

When the user closes the dialog or submits the form, `onOpenChange` is called to update the dialog state.

The form uses React Hook Form with a Zod resolver. In **create mode**, the form initializes with empty values; in **edit mode**, it is prefilled with the selected user's fields.

The `Dialog*` and `Form` components come from shadcn/ui.

```tsx title="src/features/users/components/users-action-dialog.tsx"
const formSchema = z.object(...);
type UserForm = z.infer<typeof formSchema>

type UserActionDialogProps = {
  currentRow?: User
  open: boolean
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
}

export function UsersActionDialog({
  currentRow,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: UserActionDialogProps) {
  const isEdit = !!currentRow
  const form = useForm<UserForm>({
    resolver: zodResolver(formSchema),
    defaultValues: isEdit
      ? {
          ...currentRow,
          password: '',
          confirmPassword: '',
          isEdit,
        }
      : {
          firstName: '',
          lastName: '',
          username: '',
          email: '',
          role: '',
          phoneNumber: '',
          password: '',
          confirmPassword: '',
          isEdit,
        },
  })

  const onSubmit = (values: UserForm) => {
    form.reset()
    console.log(values)
    onOpenChange(false)
  }

  const isPasswordTouched = !!form.formState.dirtyFields.password

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(nextOpen) => {
        form.reset()
        onOpenChange(nextOpen)
      }}
    >
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{isEdit ? 'Edit User' : 'Add New User'}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {isEdit ? 'Update the user here. ' : 'Create new user here. '}
            Click save when you&apos;re done.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className='h-105 w-[calc(100%+0.75rem)] overflow-y-auto py-1 pe-3'>
          <Form {...form}>
            <form
              id='user-form'
              onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
              className='space-y-4 px-0.5'
            >
              {/* Form fields */}
            </form>
          </Form>
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button type='submit' form='user-form'>
            Save changes
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  )
}
```
